patches.valueJson: {"id":"s144-4","title":"固定表达：因强烈情绪而难以自控","meaning":"be beside oneself 表示情绪极其激动，难以保持平静或自控。","usageNote":"oneself 随主语变为 myself、yourself、herself、himself 等；常用 with + 情绪名词说明是哪一种强烈情绪。","examples":[{"id":"e144-4a","senseId":"s144-4","en":"When her missing dog came home, Mia was beside herself with joy.","zh":"走失的狗回家时，米娅欣喜若狂。","note":"herself 与主语 Mia 对应；with joy 表示强烈的喜悦。"},{"id":"e144-4b","senseId":"s144-4","en":"Leo was beside himself with worry when his little sister did not come home on time.","zh":"妹妹没有按时回家时，利奥担心得几乎无法平静。","note":"himself 与主语 Leo 对应；with worry 表示极度担忧。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"be beside oneself with + 情绪名词","zh":"因某种强烈情绪而难以自控","note":"反身代词必须与主语对应，如 I was beside myself、she was beside herself。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"beside oneself with joy/worry/anger","zh":"欣喜若狂／担忧至极／愤怒得难以自控","note":"with 后的情绪可以是正面的，也可以是负面的。","kind":"fixed-expression"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"be overjoyed","zh":"喜出望外","note":"在喜悦语境下意思接近，但本身不强调难以自控，不能用于担忧或愤怒。"},{"en":"be distraught","zh":"忧心如焚；极度烦乱","note":"可对应强烈担忧或悲伤等负面情绪，不用于欣喜若狂。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"stay calm","zh":"保持冷静","note":"在情绪是否平静、能否自控的语境中形成对照。"}],"similarNote":"要根据具体情绪选择近义表达，喜悦与担忧不能混用。","contrastingNote":"stay calm 对照的是情绪状态，与空间位置无关。"},"sourceIds":[]}

sourceEvidence.text: Beside developed from the Old English two-word expression be sidan, referring to being by someone’s or something’s side. Sidan was a grammatical form of side. The expression later became one word; the initial element belongs to the historical by-like prefix, not the modern verb be.
